svg.title: Scene 2: Hashtag Cloud Transition
svg.desc: Two keyframes: a seated person scrolls complete social-media comments as the phone moves to center; a separate transition gathers the highlighted terms into a full-screen hashtag cloud.
svg.metadata: Scene 2 | Hashtag Cloud Transition | Editable vector storyboard. Existing Storyset art is embedded as SVG; all other visuals are hand-edited vector shapes, not generated images.

text.tspan: 02B · SEPARATE TRANSITION → HASHTAGS GATHER AND FILL THE SCREEN
